data.text/markdown:
Riding lab

Questions about how the rider rides, on the lab database (build_db.py). Marimo notebooks save no outputs, so nothing private reaches the public repo. Write findings up as aggregates only (no stop names, no per-stop counts).
3958 counted trips, 2024-03-18 00:00:00 to 2026-11-24 00:00:00 (matches the app's total).

1. Does weather change how much you ride?

Toronto days only, excluding days with trips in another city. Negative binomial model of trips per day, with month and weekday fixed effects so seasons and schedule changes don't masquerade as weather.

2. How often do you break routine?

A "new pair" is a start→end stop pair never ridden before; a "new end" is a destination never reached before. Stops are grouped the app's way (stop_canon.py). The graded slice (clean TTC texted trips) is what the prediction scoreboard grades, so the new-pair share there is roughly the ceiling for any model that only learns from your own history.

3. When did your riding change?

Weekly trip counts (all counted trips). Look for lasting level shifts, e.g. a move or a new schedule, rather than single busy weeks.
